theorems.name: Submission.contDiff_radial_profile_of_eq_one_le_half
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : Rn m) (ρ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → (∀ t, t ≤ 1 / 2 → φ t = 1) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Rn m => φ (‖x - ξ‖ / ρ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
